title_or_subject: Executive order(s) of 20 July 1899 reserving the Kahauiki Military Reservation (Fort Shafter) and the Waianae-Uka (Schofield Barracks) Military Reservation, Oahu, Hawaii; unnumbered

sources.what: Wikisource mirror, EO 1137 (Taft, Nov 15, 1909) correcting description of Schofield Barracks reservation
sources.quote: the Executive Order declaring the same, dated July 20, 1899
set aside for military purposes by Executive order dated July 20, 1899
Two major tracts were assigned to the War Department, the Kahauiki and Wai'anae-uka ahupua 'a, in 1899.

queries_tried: Schofield Barracks Waianae-Uka military reservation executive order July 20, 1899 McKinley
Fort Shafter Kahauiki military reservation ... 20 July 1899
fetches of EO 1137, 5607, 9995 (Truman Library), Denix Fort Shafter
notes: WPA unnumbered entries 1094 (Schofield Barracks, formerly Waianae, 14,400 acres) and 1095 (Kahauiki / Fort Shafter) share this date; EO 5132 and EO 5607 show the Kahauiki reservation was set aside by the 20 July 1899 order, and EO 1137 (Taft, 15 Nov 1909), EO 9995 and others show the Waianae-Uka (Schofield) reservation was declared by an order of the same date, so one date appears to cover orders for both reservations. The order text itself was not found. This citing order (EO 10454) concerns the Waianae-Uka (Schofield Barracks) reservation. President inferred from date, not stated in the sources.
